activity.notes: Gusmão was sworn in as the first President of the restored independent Democratic Republic of Timor-Leste on 20 May 2002 and completed the five-year mandate in May 2007.

sources.title: Biography - Kay Rala Xanana Gusmão
sources.citation_text: The Government of Timor-Leste records Gusmão's election and swearing-in as President on 20 May 2002, service through May 2007, and his August 2007 swearing-in as Prime Minister, with his decision to step down before the Sixth Constitutional Government in February 2015.

sources.title: Succession of Governments, general elections and legislatures
sources.citation_text: The Government of Timor-Leste records the presidential mandate beginning 20 May 2002 and the Fourth Constitutional Government under Xanana Gusmão beginning 8 August 2007.
